label: rollback removes order and intent
sql: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM outbox WHERE id='rolled_back') outbox_rows,(SELECT count(*) FROM purchase WHERE id='rolled_back') purchase_rows

label: commit keeps order and intent together
sql: SELECT p.id order_id,o.id outbox_id FROM purchase p JOIN outbox o ON (p.tenant,p.request_id)=(o.tenant,o.request_id) WHERE p.id='o83'

label: worker A claims epoch 1
sql: UPDATE job SET epoch=epoch+1,lease_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '1 hour',status='running' WHERE tenant='t4' AND id='j81' RETURNING epoch

label: worker B reclaims expired work
sql: UPDATE job SET epoch=epoch+1,lease_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '1 hour' WHERE id='j81' AND lease_until<clock_timestamp() RETURNING epoch

label: stale A reaches actual effect authority and is rejected
sql: WITH authorised AS (SELECT tenant,id,epoch FROM job WHERE tenant=$1 AND id=$2 AND epoch=$3 AND lease_until>clock_timestamp() FOR UPDATE) INSERT INTO effect SELECT tenant,id,epoch,$4 FROM authorised ON CONFLICT(tenant,job) DO NOTHING RETURNING *

label: current B produces effect
sql: WITH authorised AS (SELECT tenant,id,epoch FROM job WHERE tenant=$1 AND id=$2 AND epoch=$3 AND lease_until>clock_timestamp() FOR UPDATE) INSERT INTO effect SELECT tenant,id,epoch,$4 FROM authorised ON CONFLICT(tenant,job) DO NOTHING RETURNING *

label: B repeats after missing effect reply
sql: WITH authorised AS (SELECT tenant,id,epoch FROM job WHERE tenant=$1 AND id=$2 AND epoch=$3 AND lease_until>clock_timestamp() FOR UPDATE) INSERT INTO effect SELECT tenant,id,epoch,$4 FROM authorised ON CONFLICT(tenant,job) DO NOTHING RETURNING *

label: batch worker skips locked j82 and claims j83
sql: WITH candidate AS (SELECT tenant,id FROM job WHERE status='ready' OR(status='running' AND lease_until<clock_timestamp()) ORDER BY tenant,id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 10) UPDATE job j SET status='running',epoch=j.epoch+1,lease_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '1 minute' FROM candidate c WHERE(j.tenant,j.id)=(c.tenant,c.id) RETURNING j.*

label: later batch claims previously locked j82
sql: WITH candidate AS (SELECT tenant,id FROM job WHERE status='ready' OR(status='running' AND lease_until<clock_timestamp()) ORDER BY tenant,id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 10) UPDATE job j SET status='running',epoch=j.epoch+1,lease_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '1 minute' FROM candidate c WHERE(j.tenant,j.id)=(c.tenant,c.id) RETURNING j.*
